newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse halts Rattana Real Estate trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse halts Rattana Real Estate trade.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand said trading in shares of Rattana Real Estate Plc would be halted in the afternoon session on Friday as it awaited some undisclosed information from the company.
Rattana closed down 0.70 baht at 8.90 on Thursday.

Local newspapers reported today that a construction company had filed a bankruptcy suit against Rattana Real Estate after the property firm allegedly failed to make payment for some construction to the contractor.
A Rattana official declined to comment on the report but said a clarification would be issued through the bourse later today.
